study type: Feasibility study (Ecological Momentary Assessment within an existing longitudinal cohort)
exposure: REDCap for Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA) setup
Survey notification method (email vs. SMS text message)
cohort: Participants were 66 parent-child dyads (children aged 9-13 years old) recruited from an existing longitudinal cohort study.
finding: The study demonstrated the feasibility of using REDCap for ecological momentary assessment (EMA) with parents and children, achieving good completion rates that were higher with SMS notifications and on weekdays.
